items.title: Prescribed Abelian residues in every connected component of every positive-genus stratum
items.difficulty_reason: H2: realizing a residue vector somewhere in a positive-genus stratum does not control its connected component. The independent author construction occurs in genus1, where polarized flat domains and a cylinder are assembled while controlling the gcd rotation invariant of two homology loops. The all-zero-residue and all-double-pole boundary cases require special loop-index constructions, including rotation1 and, for odd pole count, rotation2; the usual interval of gluing parameters alone misses those components. Named Boissy component reachability and residue-preserving handle/zero-splitting operations then extend this component control to higher genus and multiple zeros. These new rotation-sensitive constructions are credited H2; prior genus0 classifications and component theorems are explicit reused inputs, not a new H3 charge.

editorial_notes: Retain original author statements/proofs and all inline TikZ illustrations unchanged; author mathematics is not independently certified, corrected or supplemented.
Types have strictly positive zero orders, higher pole orders b_j>=2 and s simple poles. Preserve the partition sum 2g-2 and the exclusion of the empty one-simple-pole strata.
Residual space is C^p times (C*)^s with total sum zero: residues at higher order poles may vanish, simple-pole residues cannot.
Author residue convention is 2*pi*i times the usual analytic residue; retain it for gluing, flat periods and cylinder statements.
Primitive integral signed residue data use the collective gcd of all positive integers equal to1 and a common nonzero complex scaling factor, not pairwise coprimality.

Old2063 is exactly the one-zero all-simple-pole theorem with threshold s-2; its sufficient H2 difficulty judgment and original connection-tree proof are reused, not requalified, broadened or counted again.

Source native1196/PDF22 prints s1=s2=s/2-1 in the two-component discussion; native1782/PDF27 prints the elliptic base zero order a-2g. Keep both source passages literally with explicit notation observations; supply no corrected counts/orders, added hypotheses or assistant proof.

The paper explicitly identifies GT17 predecessor versions and an equivalent Eremenko simple-pole result. Current fixed-source/author/predecessor/co-axial screening found no such active master entry; this is a corpus dedup observation, not a mathematical novelty claim.
Named Boissy, BCGGM, Kontsevich-Zorich and Naveh prior results are preserved as source inputs; their proofs or variants are not assistant-generated or separately counted.
Every connected component is essential; do not weaken to existence somewhere in the stratum or classify components from scratch.
Preserve exact rotation gcd of zero/pole orders and both loop indices, including proper-divisor exception for one zero/one pole.
Original native1782/PDF27 elliptic base order a-2g is retained literally and noted; no corrected base order or independent handle proof is inserted.
